composio.note: Composio has no managed OAuth app for Gusto, so you must supply your own client ID and secret in a custom auth config.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed OAuth app for Gusto, so you must register your own Gusto application and supply its client ID and secret to Composio.

scenarios.label: Production app for outside customers
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your AI agent connects Gusto accounts of customers outside your company, directly or via an approved Unified API partner.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count and security documents to gather, not measured

waiting.basis: No review timeline found in the dossier

scenarios.approval: Production Pre-Approval reviewed by Partnerships, then a Security Review by Gusto's GRC team. Gusto may refuse eligibility.

prerequisites.title: Security documentation ready
prerequisites.detail: Gather current audits (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001 with SOA, PCI DSS), penetration test reports and policies. Without a formal audit, you must describe controls such as multi-factor authentication and encryption.

prerequisites.title: Security and incident contacts
prerequisites.detail: Provide name, title and email for a security contact and an incident response contact.

prerequisites.title: Eligibility as a partner
prerequisites.detail: Gusto limits API access to approved partners and does not currently support early-stage products without a small-business track record.

steps.title: Confirm eligibility with Gusto
steps.detail: Check that your product fits Gusto's partner criteria before investing time.
steps.done_when: You know Gusto will consider your product.

steps.title: Prepare security review documents
steps.detail: Draft the list of audits, pen test reports, policies and control descriptions to submit.
steps.done_when: A complete document pack and contact details are ready.

steps.title: File Production Pre-Approval application
steps.detail: Submit the application with business and security details. No further action is needed until Gusto replies.

steps.title: Wait for Partnerships and Security Review
steps.detail: Partnerships reviews first, then GRC starts the Security Review. Reply quickly to extra requests because the review is on hold meanwhile.
steps.done_when: Gusto approves and issues production access.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a Composio auth config for the gusto toolkit with your own client ID and secret, using the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
inputs: Client ID and secret from dev.gusto.com/applications
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection works in sandbox.

traps.title: Sandbox keys do not reach real customers
traps.detail: Keys from the Developer Portal are sandbox only. Production keys come only after approval.

traps.title: Review stalls on unanswered requests
traps.detail: Gusto may ask for more information and puts the Security Review on hold until you respond.

traps.title: No managed app fallback
traps.detail: Composio has no managed OAuth for Gusto, so you cannot skip registering your own app.

blockers.what_it_means: Production Pre-Approval and Security Review are not yet approved.
blockers.what_to_do: Complete the application and respond to Gusto's information requests.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft security documentation and control descriptions.

blockers.what_it_means: Gusto restricts API access to approved partners and excludes early-stage products without a small-business track record.
blockers.what_to_do: Contact Gusto Partnerships to discuss eligibility.
